text.en:
The sitios of San Jose and San Pedro in the barrio of Bagong Silang, Municipality of Tagkawayan, Province of Quezon, are separated from said barrios and constituted into distinct and independent barrios of said municipality to be known as the barrios of San Jose and San Pedro, respectively.
The barrio of San Jose shall be bounded in the North by Barrio of San Pedro, on the East by Barrio Bagong Silang, on the South by Cabibihan, and on the West by Gumihan Creek; and the barrio of San Pedro shall be bounded on the North by public forest, one the East by public forest, on the South by Barrio Sta. Monica, and on the West by municipal boundary of the municipalities of Calauag and Tagkawayan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
